meta.description: Freestyle wrestling program in the Caucasus. Ancestral Dagestani methods, leg rides, chain wrestling, daily sparring, world champion coaches.

hero.label: WRESTLING · DAGESTAN
hero.title: THE DISCIPLINE THAT FORGED THE CAUCASUS
hero.subtitle: Freestyle wrestling only, at the heart of Dagestan. The ancestral methods passed down in the gyms of Makhachkala and Kaspiysk.

tldr.title: In short · Wrestling Program
facts: Freestyle wrestling exclusively (no Greco-Roman) in Dagestan, Makhachkala and Kaspiysk.
15 spots per official session. Open to adults and children 8-17 with a parent (Family tunnel).
6 technical modules: takedowns, Dagestani leg rides, chain wrestling, funk rolls, mat returns, defense.
Daily sparring with local wrestlers from the pipeline that has produced 30+ Olympic medalists.
Schedule: sessions at 10:30 and 17:30, 6 days a week. Combo Wrestling + MMA available as Custom Camp.

description.label: THE PROGRAM
description.title: WRESTLING IN DAGESTAN
description.p1: In Dagestan, wrestling is not a sport. It is an identity. Every village has its champion, every family passes down its techniques. Dagestani methods have produced more Olympic wrestling champions per capita than anywhere else in the world.
description.p2: The MKR program gives you access to this knowledge: freestyle wrestling exclusively, and the specific techniques of the Caucasus that you will find in no European academy.
description.img1_alt: Coach Gereev in a full session in the Dagestani wrestling gym
description.img2_alt: Wrestling ground bridge, an ancestral exercise practiced in groups in Dagestan

cinematic.alt: Wrestling gym in Dagestan, banner 'Wrestlers are not born, they are made', wrestlers warming up
cinematic.label: HERITAGE
cinematic.title: WRESTLERS ARE NOT BORN, THEY ARE MADE
cinematic.tagline: Борцами не рождаются, борцами становятся. The motto written on the walls of Dagestani gyms.

lutte_libre.title: Freestyle wrestling
lutte_libre.desc: Explosive takedowns, leg control, scrambles. The base of combat in Dagestan.

leg_rides.title: Leg rides
leg_rides.desc: Dagestani specialty. Ground control with the legs. A technique you will not find in Europe.

chain_wrestling.title: Chain wrestling
chain_wrestling.desc: Sequence of takedowns. If the first fails, the second is already on the way.

funk_rolls.title: Funk rolls
funk_rolls.desc: Acrobatic position recoveries. Turn a defensive situation into an attack.

mat_returns.title: Mat returns
mat_returns.desc: Bring the opponent back to the ground from the standing position. A control technique.

defense.title: Takedown defense
defense.desc: Sprawl, underhooks, counter-attacks. Cancel the opponent's attack and regain the initiative.

technique.desc: Demonstration by the coach. Repetition in pairs. Individual corrections.

conditioning.desc: Final circuit: push-ups, squats, wrestling bridge, core work.

AT THE SOURCE.

description.label: THE PROGRAM
description.title: WRESTLING FOR THE YOUNG
description.p1: In Dagestan, you start wrestling very young. The world champions all learned the same moves there, in the same gyms, with the same coaches. MKR opens this access to young European athletes, in a setting adapted to their age.
description.p2: The Youth Wrestling program is led by coaches trained in youth teaching. Progression remains gradual, never forced. The objective: pass on passion and fundamentals, without pressure or premature competition.
description.img1_alt: Young wrestlers lined up on the mat, Dagestani wrestling school
description.img2_alt: Young wrestler in solo warm-up, wrestling gym in Dagestan

cinematic.alt: Young Dagestani wrestler in stance, training gym in Makhachkala
cinematic.label: TRANSMISSION
cinematic.title:
THE RIGHT MOVE,
FIRST AND FOREMOST
cinematic.tagline: Fundamentals first. Confidence, technique, respect for the mat. Everything starts there.

pedagogie.title: Progressive teaching
pedagogie.desc: Fundamentals first. We build the right move before intensity. Each child progresses at their own pace.

encadrement.title: Specialized supervision
encadrement.desc: Coaches trained in youth teaching. Reinforced safety, adapted communication, individual follow-up.

heritage.title: Dagestani heritage
heritage.desc: The ancestral techniques of the Caucasus, passed down with patience to new generations.

esprit.title: Spirit of the mat
esprit.desc: Respect, discipline, perseverance. Wrestling forges character as much as the body.

groupes.title: Level groups
groupes.desc: Sessions by age and level. Learning adapted, without competition pressure.

cadre.title: Safe setting
cadre.desc: Equipped gyms, certified mats, constant supervision. Parents can attend the sessions.

echauffement.desc: Games, mobility, activation. Gradual and supportive start.

technique.desc: Step-by-step demonstration. Falls, stances, first grips. Guided repetition.

drills.desc: Pair application, similar levels. The coach circulates and corrects.

situations.desc: Supervised scenarios. Never free sparring, always under coach control.

retour.desc: Stretching, debrief, key points. Each child leaves with a goal for the next session.

for_parents.label: FOR PARENTS
for_parents.title: YOUR CHILD IS IN GOOD HANDS
for_parents.body: Dedicated youth coach, 1 to 5 ratio, participating parent mandatory, briefing after each session. The full details of the family setting (safety, accommodation, parallel program, Family package from {familyBase1week}) are on the Family Camp page.

hero.label: MMA · CHECHNYA
hero.title: STRIKE. TAKEDOWN. SUBMIT.
hero.subtitle: Complete MMA program in Grozny, Chechnya. The methods of the Akhmat team and the new generation of combat.

tldr.title: In short · MMA Program
facts: Exclusive MMA camp in Grozny, Chechnya. 15 spots per official session.
Advanced level minimum required (5+ years of regular practice or competitor).
6 technical modules: stand-up, clinch, takedowns, ground and pound, submissions, transitions.
Daily sparring with fighters from Akhmat Fight Club and the Chechen MMA scene.
Schedule: sessions at 11:00 and 18:00, 6 days a week. Combo Wrestling + MMA available as Custom Camp.

description.label: THE PROGRAM
description.title: MMA IN CHECHNYA
description.p1: Chechnya is one of the toughest MMA ecosystems in the world. MKR's partner coaches teach complete MMA, inherited from the wrestling tradition and enriched by years of international competition within Akhmat Fight Club and the Grozny structures.
description.p2: Each session is structured: technique, drills, sparring. The level adapts to each participant, but intensity stays high for all. The MMA camp is based exclusively in Grozny.
description.img1_alt: MMA sparring pads in the Akhmat Fight Club gym in Grozny, Chechnya, in front of a portrait of Ramzan Kadyrov
description.img2_alt: Fighter throws a precise hook on coach pads, RCA equipment, Grozny gym

cinematic.alt: Intense face-to-face MMA sparring in the Akhmat gym of Grozny, red gloves, focused eyes
cinematic.label: THE CHECHEN LEVEL
cinematic.title: SPAR WITH THE BEST
cinematic.tagline: Sessions shared with Akhmat Fight Club fighters and the new wave of Grozny. The intensity you will not reproduce anywhere in Europe.

chimaev.label: SPARRING LEVEL
chimaev.title: THE STABLE OF CHAMPIONS
chimaev.p1_before: The Akhmat Fight Club gym trains several top-ranked fighters in the world, including
chimaev.p1_after: , top 5 UFC welterweight. Our partner coaches are the same ones who train this generation.
chimaev.p2: During your camp, you share the mat with fighters who have this level in their blood and who calibrate their sparring to your level. The pressure and technical precision are immediately noticeable.
chimaev.img_alt: Khamzat Chimaev, top 5 UFC welterweight, in the Akhmat Fight Club gym of Grozny with a coach holding a UFC interim belt
chimaev.img_caption: Khamzat Chimaev (top 5 UFC welterweight) · Akhmat Fight Club gym, Grozny

briefing.label: COACHING STAFF
briefing.title: DEBRIEF AFTER EVERY SESSION
briefing.p1: The Akhmat coaches never let you finish a session without a technical debrief. The corrections are precise, individual, and based on thousands of versions of the same move observed and corrected.
briefing.p2: This short technical loop (technique, drills, sparring, debrief) is the DNA of the Chechen school and explains why Grozny fighters progress so fast.
briefing.img_alt: Coach Akhmat Power in briefing with 4 fighters after the technical session

stand_up.title: Stand-up
stand_up.desc: Boxing, kickboxing, elbow and knee strikes. Work on distance and timing.

clinch.title: Clinch
clinch.desc: Wall control, dirty boxing, projections from the clinch. Caucasian specialty.

takedowns.title: Takedowns
takedowns.desc: Singles, doubles, body locks. Integration of wrestling techniques into MMA.

ground_pound.title: Ground and Pound
ground_pound.desc: Ground control, striking from dominant position. Guard management.

soumissions.title: Submissions
soumissions.desc: Chokes, arm and leg locks. Sequences from transitions.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.desc: Fluid stand-up to ground transitions. Scrambles, position recoveries. The strong point of the Caucasus.

technique.desc: Demonstration and repetition in pairs. Focus of the day.

sparring.desc: 5-minute rounds. Intensity adapted to the level.

debrief.desc: Coach feedback, key points, individual feedback.
